desc:
The foreman said it was a quick job. Then the roof came down, and now the only way out is through the rock.

Dig your way out of the collapsed mine to find the exit... and discover the cave isn't done with you yet.

How to play:
⛏️ Mine the rock wall and sell your haul at the cart
🔧 Buy and upgrade your pickaxe, drill, dynamite and car to dig faster
💎 Find gold, emeralds, rubies and hidden diamonds in the rock
👀 Meet whoever else is stuck down here
🚪 Reach the end of the tunnel to unlock the ENDING!

9 miner classes, Easy and Hard mode. Play solo or bring up to 3 friends. Beat your best time!
